controles.affirmation: Remboursement partiel de tarifs obtenu apres une decision de la Cour supreme "invalidant leur base legale" ; 106 M$ (tarifs 2025) et 23 M$ (tarifs 2026) ; impact -68 M$ sur le resultat d'exploitation au T2 2026
controles.verbatim_source: "In February 2026, the U.S. Supreme Court ruled that the International Emergency Economic Powers Act (“IEEPA”) does not authorize the President to impose tariffs thereunder... U.S. Customs and Border Protection announced a new administrative process for importers to obtain refunds of certain tariffs imposed under IEEPA." ; "we recognized pre-tax benefits from tariff refunds of $106 million related to tariffs incurred in 2025 and $23 million related to tariffs incurred in 2026" ; "Tariffs negatively impacted our Operating income by $68 million and $156 million for the three and six months ended June 30, 2026"
controles.correction_proposee: Les chiffres sont exacts. Mais la Cour supreme n'a invalide que le fondement IEEPA, pas l'ensemble des tarifs imposes depuis fevrier 2025, et les remboursements ne portent que sur "certain tariffs imposed under IEEPA". Ecrire : "une decision de la Cour supreme invalidant le recours a l'IEEPA comme base legale d'une partie de ces tarifs".
